name: proofrank
description: A read-only pre-migration evidence gate for long-lived websites.

interface.shortDescription: Protect old pages before a redesign or migration.
interface.longDescription: Reconcile saved SEO, CMS, crawler, sitemap, and HTML evidence before a long-lived website is redesigned or moved. ProofRank keeps source-universe and active-HTML gates separate, labels confirmed/candidate/withheld evidence, and emits a read-only WITHHOLD or READY_FOR_HUMAN_REVIEW contract for people and automation.
defaultPrompt: Check whether this old site is ready for a safe redesign or migration without changing anything.
Find orphan and internal-link candidates from this cache.
Explain what is confirmed, candidate, or withheld by the current coverage.
